"""Parameter-free rest-rule deletion, with fully matched post-policy tuning."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from pressure_data import mil, read
from whole_reference import write
from rc_action_runtime import sufficient, policy_predictions, macro_scores, POST
from landscape_audit import multilabel_metrics

ROOT = Path('research/overlay-quality/break-regularity-r1')


def declare():
    protocol = dict(
        intervention='Delete only the small-chord/high-vibro/regular-rhythm lowStakes disjunct, which has no absolute density limit.',
        parameters='No new gate threshold or model coefficient. All 245 declared dominantShare x mixShare x secondRel policies retuned independently per arm. Other original constants fixed for attribution.',
        selection='Each original outer TRAIN: pool its three INNER validation sets, maximize full17 macroF1 then macroRecall then lowest policyId. The deterministic local classifier has no fitted parameters; fold predictions are identical before post selection.',
        finalPolicy='If adopted, choose one policy by mean of six saved INNER macroF1 arrays, then mean recall, then lowest id. Never choose a policy from outer scores.',
        scope='Retrospective original349 whole +6manual and actively queried F01/F02; historical data already repeatedly observed. No new blind test.',
        acceptance='Inspect all P/R/F1, exact/tag accuracy, per-class FP/FN identities, manual primary intervals and Break false positives/false negatives. Do not adopt from F examples alone.',
        source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf8'))
    file=ROOT/'post-protocol.json'
    if file.exists() and read(file)!=protocol:raise ValueError('Frozen post protocol changed')
    if not file.exists():write(file,protocol)


def run():
    declare();read(ROOT/'complete.json')
    main,manual,_=mil.load();uids=[r['uid']for r in main]
    rows={r['uid']:r for r in read(ROOT/'frames.json')}
    y=mil.encode(main);w=np.array([r['recordWeight']for r in main]);groups=[r['group']for r in main]
    plans=read('research/rework/results/mil-stage1-r4/protocol.json')['plans']
    results={};all_choices=[];predictions={};final=[]
    fixed_policy=dict(dominantShare=.52,mixShare=.07,secondRel=.75)
    for arm in ['original','candidate']:
        stats=[sufficient(rows[u][arm])for u in uids]
        p=policy_predictions(stats);heldout=np.zeros_like(y);inner_scores=[];inner_recalls=[]
        choices=[]
        for outer,plan in enumerate(plans):
            ids=[i for s in plan['inner']for i in s['validation']]
            if len(ids)!=len(set(ids))or set(ids)!=set(plan['train']):raise ValueError('INNER does not partition outer TRAIN')
            f,r=macro_scores(y[ids],p[:,ids],w[ids]);pid=max(range(len(POST)),key=lambda i:(f[i],r[i],-i))
            choices.append(dict(arm=arm,outer=outer,policyId=pid,policy=POST[pid],innerF1=float(f[pid]),innerRecall=float(r[pid]),usesOuterTruth=False))
            heldout[plan['test']]=p[pid,plan['test']]
            inner_scores.append(f);inner_recalls.append(r)
        # Save INNER-only choices before accessing outer metrics.
        all_choices.extend(choices);write(ROOT/'post-selection.json',all_choices)
        f=np.mean(inner_scores,axis=0);r=np.mean(inner_recalls,axis=0)
        pid=max(range(len(POST)),key=lambda i:(f[i],r[i],-i))
        final.append(dict(arm=arm,policyId=pid,policy=POST[pid],meanInnerF1=float(f[pid]),meanInnerRecall=float(r[pid]),usesOuterTruth=False))
        for name,q in [(arm+'/retuned',heldout),(arm+'/fixed',policy_predictions(stats,[fixed_policy])[0])]:
            m=multilabel_metrics(y,q,w,mil.MAP_CLASSES,groups)
            m['perClassErrors']={c:{label:[uids[i]for i in np.flatnonzero(mask)]for label,mask in
                [('FP',(y[:,j]==0)&q[:,j].astype(bool)),('FN',(y[:,j]==1)&~q[:,j].astype(bool))]}for j,c in enumerate(mil.MAP_CLASSES)}
            results[name]=m;predictions[name]=q.astype(int).tolist()
    write(ROOT/'final-inner-policy.json',final)
    locals=read(ROOT/'local.json');player=read(ROOT/'player.json')
    local_summary={arm:dict(equalChartAccuracy=float(np.mean([r[arm]['accuracy']for r in locals])),
        byChart={r['uid']:r[arm]['accuracy']for r in locals},
        falseBreakMs=sum(sum(d['end']-d['start']for d in r[arm]['details']if d['predicted']=='break'and'break'not in d['truth'])for r in locals),
        missedBreakMs=sum(sum(d['end']-d['start']for d in r[arm]['details']if d['predicted']!='break'and d['truth']==['break'])for r in locals))for arm in ['original','candidate']}
    write(ROOT/'analysis.json',dict(metrics=results,local=local_summary,player=player,choices=all_choices,finalPolicies=final,
        predictions=predictions,uids=uids,adopted=False,wholeProbabilityMetrics='Hard tag sets only; no fabricated probability metrics.'))
    lines=['# 无绝对密度上限的规则节奏休息门控：开／关对照','',
        '| 处理 | macro P | macro R | macro F1 | micro F1 | 集合全对 |','|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
    for name,m in results.items():lines.append('| '+name+' | '+' | '.join(f'{100*v:.2f}%'for v in
        [m['macro']['precision'],m['macro']['recall'],m['macro']['f1'],m['micro']['f1'],m['exactMatch']])+' |')
    lines+=['',str(local_summary),'','完整245聚合策略在两处理下各自重调；局部分类器没有新增参数。所有外折选择仅使用对应TRAIN内部资料。F01/F02是主动查询的回归例，不作随机准确率。']
    (ROOT/'REPORT.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n',encoding='utf8');print('\n'.join(lines),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys
    declare() if '--declare-only'in sys.argv else run()
